days.title: Water and Heritage in Rioseco and Beneros
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Museo de la madreña
stops.detail: The clog museum of Beneros, started by the will of a local neighborhood association, shows the manufacture and history of this typical footwear.

stops.name: Casa del Agua
stops.detail: It is a themed classroom about water, the Water House, located in Rioseco and with abundant teaching material about the park's water resources; it should not be forgotten that the park is one of the great suppliers of water for human consumption in Asturias with the presence of several reservoirs in the vicinity in the so-called Tanes-Rioseco axis that supplies 80% of the population of Asturias.

stops.name: Cascada del Tabayón de Mongayu
stops.detail: The flow of many of these streams crosses limestone formations creating very beautiful narrowings as can be seen for example in the Alba route, or even a beautiful waterfall like the Tabayón de Mongayu Waterfall.

stops.name: Museo de la madera
stops.detail: The wood museum of Campo de Caso focuses on the use and commercialization of this resource within the villages of the area.
